contribution.label: Contribution
contribution.notes: One contribution publishes the holdings of one cruise or programme — the grain the repository accessions and lifts moratoria at.

version.label: Version
version.notes: 1 for the original contribution, empty if the contribution is not activated

timestamp.label: Activation Timestamp
timestamp.description: Date and time of contribution activation

is_validated.label: Is Validated
is_validated.description: Contribution has passed the OSU-MGR Data Model validation

is_reviewed.label: Is Reviewed
is_reviewed.description: Contribution has been reviewed for correct usage of the OSU-MGR Data Model

reference.label: Contribution Reference
reference.description: DOI or citation of the publication this contribution supports
reference.notes: Repository holdings are usually accessioned before they are published

author.label: Contribution Author
author.description: EarthRef handle, ORCID, or name and email of the author of the contribution

description.label: Description
description.description: Description of the contribution as a whole

supplemental_links.label: Supplemental Links
supplemental_links.description: Links to related resources hosted elsewhere

cruises.label: Cruises
cruises.description: The cruise or programme the material was collected on
cruises.notes: Normally one row: the contribution's accession unit. Moratorium state and accession date live here because the repository manages them per cruise.

row_id.label: Row ID
row_id.description: Unique row number within the table

cruise.label: Cruise
cruise.description: Cruise or programme ID as it appears in OSU-IDs

osu_id.label: OSU-ID
osu_id.description: Persistent OSU-MGR identifier for this record
osu_id.notes: Resolves at osu-mgr.org; derived from the cruise, station and sample parts

r2r_cruise_id.label: R2R Cruise ID
r2r_cruise_id.description: Rolling Deck to Repository cruise identifier

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Repository collection the holdings belong to

rov_name.label: ROV Name
rov_name.description: Name of the remotely operated vehicle, when one was used

pi_institution.label: PI Institution
pi_institution.description: Institution the contact PI is affiliated with

accession_date.label: Accession Date
accession_date.description: Date the material was accessioned into the repository

moratorium.label: Moratorium
moratorium.description: Holdings from this cruise are under moratorium
moratorium.notes: Moratorium files are withheld from public search and download

lat_s.label: Southern Latitude
lat_s.description: Southern bound of the cruise's stations
lat_s.notes: Aggregated from the cruise's cores and dives

lat_n.label: Northern Latitude
lat_n.description: Northern bound of the cruise's stations

lon_w.label: Western Longitude
lon_w.description: Western bound of the cruise's stations

lon_e.label: Eastern Longitude
lon_e.description: Eastern bound of the cruise's stations

methods.label: Collection Methods
methods.description: Colon-delimited list of the collection methods used on this cruise
methods.notes: Rolled up from the cruise's cores and dives

materials.label: Materials
materials.description: Colon-delimited list of the materials this cruise recovered

cores.label: Cores
cores.description: A cored, grabbed or drilled station in the core hierarchy
cores.notes: Cruise -> core -> section -> section half -> core sample. Dredges, grabs and ROV stations use the dive hierarchy instead (see `dives`).

row_id.label: Row ID
row_id.description: Unique row number within the table

core.label: Core
core.description: Core name as it appears in the metadata sheet, unique within the contribution

cruise.label: Cruise
cruise.description: Cruise this core was collected on

osu_id.label: OSU-ID
osu_id.description: Persistent OSU-MGR identifier for this record
osu_id.notes: Resolves at osu-mgr.org; derived from the cruise, station and sample parts

core_number.label: Core Number
core_number.description: Numeric part of the core name, used for hierarchical sorting

method.label: Collection Method
method.description: Recovery method as displayed to users

n_sections.label: Number of Sections
n_sections.description: Number of sections the parent core was cut into

lon.label: Longitude
lon.notes: Decimal degrees east, -180 to 180 (marine convention; not MagIC's 0-360)

lat_end.label: End Latitude
lat_end.description: Latitude at the end of the station
lat_end.notes: Dredges and trawls are tracks, not points

lon_end.label: End Longitude
lon_end.description: Longitude at the end of the station

water_depth_end.label: End Water Depth
water_depth_end.description: Water depth at the end of the station

end_date.label: End Date Collected
end_date.description: Date collection at the station finished

end_time.label: End Time Collected
end_time.description: Time collection at the station finished (UTC)

area.label: Area
area.description: Named feature or region the station is in

storage_location.label: Storage Location
storage_location.description: Where the material is stored in the repository

sections.label: Sections
